show.description: Twin Trouble is a thrilling romantic drama laced with secrets, betrayal, and supernatural twists. Kajal, desperate to save her ailing mother, is forced into a shocking deal by her estranged twin Diya—to live as her and enter a dangerous contract marriage with the mysterious billionaire Ali Mittal. But as Kajal’s path collides with Shaurya, a man tied to her past in ways she doesn’t yet know, love, lies, and haunting truths spiral into a storm she cannot escape.
